privacy: Balance, application ID and complete/partial token are opaque-masked before screenshot capture. Dialog crops omit unrelated UI.
edits: Crop + numbered callouts on live screenshot only; no UI data or success state fabricated.
capture_actions: Read application page, open Manage Keys, open Create, fill example name, cancel; no credential created and no billable API call.

instructions.1: Copy the selected existing key. The screenshot redacts it. Paste only token in Dify, not the Bearer label.
instructions.2: Manage Keys, then Create; use own key name and appropriate restrictions. Return to the list/application page to copy.

published_screenshot_language: English only in every locale, per explicit user instruction
